note: Platforms Romwright does not support, each with the fact that blocks it. Tier 1 means a committed gate report measures it; the support matrix generator refuses to print a tier-1 claim whose gate report is missing, so a platform is listed here only once someone has looked. Evidence paths are relative to the pinned Ghidra install (docs/upstream-ghidra.md) unless stated otherwise; they were checked against Ghidra 12.1.3.

platforms.blocker: The Allegrex core's VFPU is not modelled by any pinned SLEIGH language, so PSP code that uses vector instructions cannot be decoded, let alone decompiled. Adding it means writing a SLEIGH extension, which is its own task with its own gate.
platforms.evidence: Ghidra/Processors: zero files match 'allegrex' or 'vfpu'; MIPS/data/languages/mips.ldefs offers variants default, R6, micro, 16e, 64-32addr only.

platforms.blocker: The Emotion Engine's 128-bit multimedia instructions (MMI) and VU macro-mode operations do not decode: the pinned MIPS language mentions r5900 only as an IDA-PRO name mapping and defines no R5900 variant. Importing a PS2 ELF would decode the scalar subset and silently drop the rest.
platforms.evidence: MIPS/data/languages/mips.ldefs:127 external_name tool="IDA-PRO" name="r5900r" with no matching variant; zero matches for PADDW, PSUBW, QFSRV or PMFHL across MIPS/data/languages/*.sinc.

platforms.blocker: There is no SPU processor at all in the pinned tree, so SPU modules have no decoder. The PPU side is PowerPC, but an RE platform that decompiles only the PPU half of a PS3 title would misrepresent what it recovered.
platforms.evidence: Ghidra/Processors contains no SPU or Cell directory; zero .ldefs files declare an SPU processor.

platforms.blocker: VMX128 is not modelled: the pinned PowerPC language defines 64 VSX registers and no VMX128 variant, while the Xenon core exposes 128 vector registers with different encodings. Retail XEX images are also encrypted and compressed, which the encrypted-container row also covers.
platforms.evidence: PowerPC/data/languages/ppc_common.sinc:150 defines vs0..vs63; zero matches for 'vmx128' anywhere under Ghidra/Processors; ppc.ldefs offers Altivec variants only.

platforms.blocker: Retail images are encrypted, and the keys are not in this repository or in the pinned Ghidra install. Fetching them would require a network call at runtime, which AGENTS.md II.1 reserves to the human and the project's offline guarantee forbids. Decrypted input supplied by the user is a separate, smaller task: it still needs a loader and a gate.
platforms.evidence: AGENTS.md II.1 row 'Any network call at runtime (signature DB fetch, model download)'; no key material or decryption code exists in this repository.
